items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: FreeDomain
items.summary: FreeDomain 是一个开源域名注册平台，旨在为开发者和初创项目提供免费的域名服务，降低技术项目的入门门槛。该项目采用 HTML 构建简洁的网页界面，用户可直接在线申请和管理域名，无需支付费用。开发者可将其部署到本地环境，搭建个性化的域名分发系统，或借鉴其域名分配逻辑集成到自己的应用中，非常适合用于项目演示、测试环境搭建或教育用途的实践探索。
items.summary_en: FreeDomain is an open-source platform that provides free domain registration services, addressing the barrier of domain costs for developers and small projects. Built primarily with HTML, it offers a straightforward web interface for users to claim and manage domains without financial commitment. You can deploy it locally to create custom domain services or integrate its domain management logic into your own applications for testing and development purposes.

items.name: markitdown
items.summary: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。
items.summary_en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.

items.name: claude-code
items.summary: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。
items.summary_en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands directly in your development environment. You can use it to generate boilerplate code, debug existing functions, or manage Git workflows—simply type your request in plain English and let it handle the implementation details.

items.name: data-engineering-zoomcamp
items.summary: Data Engineering Zoomcamp 是一个为期9周的免费课程，旨在教你从零构建生产级数据管道。课程涵盖Docker容器化、Kestra工作流编排、Spark批处理、Kafka流处理，以及数据仓库和dbt分析工程。通过动手实践和最终项目，你将掌握现代数据工程的核心技能。适合想进入数据工程领域的开发者，提供了一条结构化的学习路径，让你快速获得实战能力。
items.summary_en: Data Engineering Zoomcamp is a free 9-week course that teaches you to build production-ready data pipelines from scratch. It covers containerization with Docker, workflow orchestration with Kestra, batch processing with Spark, and streaming with Kafka, plus data warehousing and analytics engineering with dbt. The hands-on curriculum culminates in a capstone project where you apply all skills to a real-world dataset. Ideal for aspiring data engineers, it offers a structured path to practical, job-ready expertise.

items.name: liteparse
items.summary: LiteParse是一款快速开源文档解析器，能从PDF和图片中高精度提取文本与结构。其核心优势在于基于Rust构建的OCR流水线，通过内存安全与并发优化实现远超Python方案的解析速度与稳定性。技术亮点为模块化设计，支持自定义预处理与后处理步骤，便于针对特定文档调优。用户可通过命令行快速试用，或将其API集成至自动化数据提取、文档索引、RAG预处理等流程。适用于高效处理大量扫描件或复杂排版文档的场景。
items.summary_en: LiteParse is a fast, open-source document parser that extracts text and structure from PDFs and images with high accuracy. Its key innovation is a Rust-based OCR pipeline optimized for speed and reliability, outperforming many Python alternatives. You can use it as a CLI tool or integrate it via its API for tasks like automated data extraction, document indexing, or preprocessing for RAG systems.

items.name: esm
items.summary: ESM（进化规模建模）将大型语言模型技术应用于蛋白质序列，能够直接从序列数据预测结构、功能和进化关系。其核心创新在于从数百万天然序列中无监督学习蛋白质的“语言”，捕捉深层的进化模式。研究人员可以利用ESM进行变异效应预测、蛋白质设计，或作为基础模型针对特定生物学问题进行微调，从而加速基因组学和药物开发中的发现。
items.summary_en: ESM (Evolutionary Scale Modeling) applies large language model techniques to protein sequences, enabling prediction of structure, function, and evolutionary relationships directly from sequence data. Its core innovation is learning protein 'language' from millions of natural sequences without labels, capturing deep evolutionary patterns. Researchers can use ESM for tasks like variant effect prediction, protein design, or as a foundation for fine-tuning on specific biological problems, accelerating discovery in genomics and drug development.

items.name: plugins
items.summary: Cursor插件规范通过声明式JSON Schema定义配置，支持自定义斜杠命令、上下文提供者和模型路由等特性。开发者可创建插件添加自动代码审查或数据库查询等工作流，仅需定义动作和触发器。使用方式为克隆仓库、创建插件清单并在开发者模式下本地测试。该模块化设计无需修改核心功能即可定制编辑器，降低AI编程工具扩展门槛，便于团队快速构建和共享内部工具，提升协作效率。
items.summary_en: Cursor plugins extend the AI-powered code editor with custom commands and integrations. The specification defines a declarative JSON schema for plugin configuration, enabling features like custom slash commands, context providers, and model routing. Developers can create plugins that add specialized workflows, such as automated code reviews or database queries, by defining actions and triggers. To get started, clone the repository, create a plugin manifest, and test it locally with Cursor's developer mode. This modular approach makes it easy to tailor the editor to specific development needs without modifying core functionality.

items.name: stable-worldmodel
items.summary: Stable-WorldModel是一个面向可复现世界模型研究的平台，旨在解决从视觉观测中学习环境动态预测的挑战。其核心创新在于将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与模型预测控制结合，在不重建像素的前提下高效学习潜在表征，显著降低计算成本并保持规划精度。该平台支持世界模型基准测试、模拟环境智能体训练及机器人控制任务扩展，为模型预测控制与强化学习算法研究提供标准化工具，提升研究的可靠性与可复现性。
items.summary_en: Stable-WorldModel is a platform for reproducible world model research, addressing the challenge of building predictive models that learn environment dynamics from visual observations. Its core innovation is integrating JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) with model-predictive control, enabling efficient learning of latent representations without reconstructing pixels. This approach reduces computational cost while maintaining planning accuracy. Researchers can use it to benchmark world models, train agents in simulated environments, or extend it for robotics tasks, making it a practical tool for advancing model-based reinforcement learning.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
